name: New ODBC Driver Registered
description: Detects the registration of a new ODBC driver.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (registry.path:*\\SOFTWARE\\ODBC\\ODBCINST.INI\\* AND registry.path:*\\Driver) AND (NOT (registry.path:*\\SQL\ Server\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:%WINDIR%\\System32\\SQLSRV32.dll)) AND (NOT ((registry.path:*\\Microsoft\ Access\ * AND winlog.event_data.Details:C\:\\Progra* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\ACEODBC.DLL) OR (registry.path:*\\Microsoft\ Excel\ Driver* AND winlog.event_data.Details:C\:\\Progra* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\ACEODBC.DLL)))
